fieldValues.title: Carry origin and identity through every change
fieldValues.move: Implement the accepted RFC-046 createdBy actor, so every record and relation says who asserted it, and give a change of type its own ruled operation (a retype that keeps identity through a lineage relation; srs#322, srs#178), so no record is deleted and recreated to change its type.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Whether an attributed claim is true; provenance of knowledge that never enters SRS.
fieldValues.falsifier: A record created after RFC-046 lands with no createdBy, or a record whose type changed by delete and recreate.
source_ref: srs-programme: domain health walk of Semantic records, 2026-10-20
fieldValues.return_when: When srs-rust#1171 merges, or when the retype ruling is made.
